requirements.sourcePersistence: Inline and block payloads retain exact texExpression strings, including multiline CRLF/CR/LF, Unicode, escapes, and whitespace. Unknown fields survive source-only updates. Unknown versions remain opaque.
requirements.wordFallback: Native content controls contain readable literal LaTeX. Inline line boundaries become spaces; block line boundaries become separate paragraphs. Empty source displays a square. The payload source is unchanged.
requirements.importedOmml: Exact canonical fingerprints cover an imported inline fraction, retained vendor extension and properties, and a display equation with its full oMathPara wrapper. Both survive surrounding text edits, history, save/reopen, and real sharing.
requirements.history: Each equation insertion includes native control and payload in one history unit. Both actors retain independent undo/redo across concurrent first insertions and deletion during peer editing.
requirements.initialization: Native preparation seeds an empty existing-format payload store before room bootstrap. No actor owns its lifetime. Existing populated or invalid imports stay intact; incomplete shared setup refuses before mutation.
requirements.sharedScenario: Two fixed client orders times two delivery receivers. Offline inline/block insertions, equation deletion while a peer edits the same paragraph, both histories, remote selection geometry, saved semantic convergence, DOCX and room reopening.
